name: coal-machine
description: M4 Phase 3c scenario (epic #163; objects beyond the house): the coal-mine machine and the basket. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. troll-combat's sixteen commands, then dam-sluice's next seven to the Maintenance Room; `take wrench`, `take screwdriver`, `push yellow button`; back to the Dam, `turn bolt with wrench` (the sluice gates open, LOW-TIDE); across the drained reservoir to Reservoir North, the Atlantis Room, the Cave and Mirror Room 1; `rub mirror` (Mirror Room 2); the crawlway, the Grail Room, the Temple, the Altar: `take candles` (burning; CNDIN queued); back by the Grail Room and the crawlway to Mirror Room 2, `rub mirror`; the corridor, the Slide Room, the Mine Entrance, the Shaft Room; through the coal mine (Wooden Tunnel, four mine rooms, the ladder) to the Dead End: `take coal`; back up to the Shaft Room; `put coal in basket`, `put screwdriver in basket`, `put candles in basket`, `lower basket` (DUMBWAITER, 77act2.mud:74: CAGE-TOP false); through the mine again to the Timber Room; `drop all` (the passage south-west is for the empty-handed only: NO-OBJS, EMPTY-HANDED); `sw` to the Lower Shaft (lit by the candles in the basket: LIGHT-SHAFT scored); `take coal` `take screwdriver` `take candles`; `east` to the Machine Room; `open lid`, `put coal in machine`, `close lid`, `turn switch with screwdriver` (MSWITCH-FUNCTION, 77act2.mud:139: the coal becomes the diamond), `open lid`, `take diamond`; `nw`, `put diamond in basket`, `raise basket` (CAGE-TOP T); `inventory`; `score`. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/COAL-MACHINE-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
